title.zh: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
title.en: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding

evidence.quote: Specifically, the proposed RoPE encodes the absolute position with a rotation matrix and meanwhile incorporates the explicit relative position dependency in self-attention formulation.
As can be seen, RoFormer can significantly outperform BERT in three out of six datasets, and the improvements are considerable.
However, when increasing the maximum input text length to 1024, RoFormer outperforms WoBERT by an absolute improvement of 1.5%.

Despite the fact that we mathematically format the relative position relations as rotations under 2D sub-spaces, there lacks of thorough explanations on why it converges faster than baseline models that incorporates other position encoding strategies.

notes.zh:
问题：自注意力本身不带位置信息，已有的绝对与相对位置编码大多把位置向量加到词表示上，因此没法直接用在把注意力改写成线性形式的架构里；能不能让编码既带绝对位置、又在注意力内积中显式体现相对位置。
证据位置：方法在 §3.2（二维旋转推广到一般形式），长程衰减等性质在 §3.3 与 §3.4.3；实验在 §4，原文说明全部跑在两台各 4 张 V100 的云服务器上——WMT14 英德 BLEU 在表 1（Transformer-base 27.3、RoFormer 27.5），GLUE 六项在表 2，Performer 加 RoPE 的预训练损失曲线在 Figure 3 右图，中文长文本 CAIL2019-SCM 在表 5；局限有独立小节 §4.5.5 Limitations of the work。
作者自陈局限：§4.5.5 自己列了三条——把相对位置关系写成二维子空间里的旋转虽有数学形式，但没有充分解释为什么它比其他位置编码策略收敛更快；长程衰减性质已经证明、长文本上表现更好也观察到了，但作者说还没给出可信的解释；此外 RoFormer 建立在 Transformer 基础设施之上，预训练需要硬件资源。
它没主张的：论文没有说 RoPE 在所有下游任务上都优于 BERT——表 2 里 SST-2、QNLI、MNLI 三项 RoFormer 更低，正文自己写的口径是六项中的三项；表 5 的 1024 结果也不能读成「只在 512 上训练、直接外推到 1024」的证据，因为表 4 的分阶段预训练把最大序列长度提到过 1536；「能配线性自注意力」这一点在 §4.4 只用 Performer 的预训练损失曲线验证，没有给下游任务分数。
notes.en:
Problem: self-attention carries no position information by itself, and most existing absolute and relative encodings add a position vector to the token representation, so they cannot be used directly in architectures that rewrite attention in linear form; can an encoding carry absolute position while making relative position explicit inside the attention inner product.
Where the evidence sits: the method is in 3.2 (a 2D rotation generalised to the full form) and the long-term decay properties in 3.3 and 3.4.3; experiments are in Section 4, which states they all ran on two cloud servers with 4 V100 GPUs each — WMT14 English-German BLEU in Table 1 (Transformer-base 27.3, RoFormer 27.5), six GLUE tasks in Table 2, Performer-with-RoPE pre-training loss curves in Figure 3 (right), and Chinese long-text CAIL2019-SCM in Table 5; the limits have their own subsection, 4.5.5 Limitations of the work.
What the authors say about limits: 4.5.5 lists three — although relative position is formulated mathematically as rotations in 2D sub-spaces, there is no thorough explanation of why it converges faster than other position encoding strategies; the long-term decay property is proved and better long-text performance is observed, but the authors say they have not come up with a faithful explanation; and RoFormer is built on Transformer-based infrastructure, so pre-training requires hardware resources.
What it does not claim: the paper does not say RoPE beats BERT on every downstream task — in Table 2 RoFormer is lower on SST-2, QNLI and MNLI, and the text itself says three out of six datasets; the 1024 result in Table 5 is not evidence of train-at-512-then-extrapolate, because the staged pre-training in Table 4 raised the maximum sequence length to 1536; and compatibility with linear self-attention is supported in 4.4 only by Performer pre-training loss curves, with no downstream task scores.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §3.2–§3.4（方法与性质）；表 1、表 2、表 5、Figure 3；§4.5.5 Limitations of the work
specs.GLUE 对比口径 / GLUE: 正文写六项中的三项优于 BERT（表 2）
specs.中文长文本 / long text: CAIL2019-SCM 输入长度 1024 时较 WoBERT 绝对提升 1.5%（§4.5.4 原文口径）
specs.局限位置 / limits: §4.5.5 Limitations of the work（独立小节）
